items.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Backs National Push To Secure America’s Subsurface Resources
items.summary: ConocoPhillips (NYSE:COP) CEO Ryan Lance, in his role as chair of the National Petroleum Council, has led a new report calling for coordinated national action on assessing and securing US subsurface resources. The report urges federal and state authorities, along with industry, to build a more comprehensive picture of underground energy and storage potential across the country.
